title: Build and read many small vectors
summary: Build a few hundred vectors of 1 to 8 integers each, pushing one at a time into an inline-capacity vector and reading every element back.
notes: Cargo only: no npm or JSR package in this category. Each call builds 64 to 512 fresh vectors with inline capacity 8 from generated integers and reads every element back. Rust allocation-counting overhead is included in CPU figures.
